title: Tour with Facundo!  He’s awesome!!!
text: We did a gourmet tapas tour with Facundo… He was awesome. Did a fantastic job. Excellent communication, excellent knowledge of the area. Very pleasant to be around.
author: James L F

title: Wonderful private tapas tour!
text: Very kind and fun your guide. Mateo was so much fun to hang out with and he gave us a lovely tour of Barcelona with lots of history and fun facts! He also knew all the best spots to have tapas!! Thank you Mateo! ❤️😎
author: davidaY7260NA
